content.text: Plan Your Trip to Ibiza: Best of Ibiza TourismWhat is Travelers’ Choice Best of the Best?This award is our highest recognition and is presented annually to those businesses that are the Best of the Best on Tripadvisor, those that earn excellent reviews from travelers and are ranked in the top 1% of properties worldwide.Learn moreBy ManagementIbiza, Spain Save this place to a Trip, where you can track your faves and get personalized picks as you plan.Ibiza: Old Spanish for "party 'til you drop." Perhaps not literally, but this is definitely one of Europe's favorite nightlife playgrounds. Ibiza boasts more than 100 miles of coastline with some 50 beaches, plus plenty of restaurants, bars, and water sports—and clubs, of course. Fit in a little culture and visit Ibiza's UNESCO-designated old town.Discover your perfect IbizaLooking for places to stay, eat, or explore?Essential IbizaPick a category to filter your recsWhen to visitJanuary53 ºFColdest month3 days of rainLess busyBusiest monthFebruary54 ºF2 days of rainModerately busyMarch57 ºF3 days of rainModerately busyApril61 ºF3 days of rainModerately busyMay66 ºF2 days of rainVery busyJune74 ºF1 day of rainVery busyJuly79 ºF0 days of rainVery busyAugust80 ºFHottest month1 day of rainVery busySeptember75 ºF3 days of rainModerately busyLeast busy monthOctober69 ºF3 days of rainLess busyNovember60 ºF4 days of rainWettest monthLess busyDecember55 ºF2 days of rainLess busyRelated StoriesTrending in the forumsIbiza Is Great ForSnorkelingEat & drinkJet Boat RentalsAfter darkBoat RentalsSand & surfExplore more from our sponsorsIbiza travel tipsPowered by AIThese questions and answers were created by AI, using the most common questions travelers ask in the forums.Local Companies and PoliciesSome travelers have inquired about car rental companies in Ibiza that do not require a deposit; however, specific recommendations were not provided in the forum posts. Users have mentioned difficulty in finding car rentals with specific modifications such as hand controls, indicating limited specialized services among both local and major car rental firms.Operating Hours and LocationsRegarding the availability during late hours, Moto Luis is noted for offering car delivery services at the airport for late arrivals, with an additional charge. Travelers looking for rentals not located at the airport have had successes with small local companies that offer flexibility, such as delivery and collection from the port or other non-airport locations.Pricing ConcernsThe posts also highlight concerns about high rental prices during peak seasons, with some rentals exceeding £1000 for two weeks in the summer. There is mention of a general shortage of rental cars, suggesting that high prices might persist.Recommendations and General AdviceFor general car rental needs, local companies like Moto Luis and Autos Mari are frequently recommended by users for their reliability and services like airport pickup. These companies are often preferred over less known or new market entrants due to their established reputation and perceived value in handling issues.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Beachfront Hotel OptionsSome travelers have recommended the Riomar Hotel for its beachfront location, particularly suitable for couples in their mid-50s looking for easy access to the beach and nearby restaurants. The hotel fits a budget of around $400 per night, although it's essential to factor in fluctuating prices depending on the travel season.Alternative Beach AccommodationsOther users have suggested places like Talamanca, which offers a nice beach with good beach bars and is within walking distance or a short ferry ride from Ibiza Town. This area is highlighted for having a local feel while being close to major attractions and dining options.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Family-Friendly Beach ClubsAccording to forum posts, some beach clubs in Ibiza are suitable for families with children. El Chiringuito and the Jockey Club have been mentioned as family-friendly options.Activities for FamiliesFor many users, Ibiza offers a range of activities suitable for families. Excursion boats to Formentera, watersports, and various entertainment options in bars are available in areas like Es Canar. Additionally, hiring a car for day trips around the island is recommended for more exploration and flexibility.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Restaurants and BarsAccording to forum posts, San Antonio Bay offers a variety of hotels, bars, and restaurants along its promenade. Travelers have mentioned places like the Reggae Beach Cocktail Bar, which is known for its excellent daiquiris and cocktails.Sunset ViewsSome travelers said that for those looking to enjoy a meal with a sunset view, options like Mambo and HOSTAL LA TORRE are recommended, although they might come with a higher price tag. Another suggested spot is Tigre Morada, located near Port des Torrent, which offers sunset views with a DJ playing music.Family-Friendly ActivitiesFor many users, San Antonio Bay is considered family-friendly compared to the more lively San Antonio. It's described as a quieter area with small cove beaches, suitable for families seeking a relaxed environment.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Beach and Water AttractionsAccording to forum posts, San Antonio, Ibiza, offers access to various nearby beaches such as Cala Gracio, Cala Conta, Cala Tarida, and Cala Bassa, which are reachable by bus or water taxi. Port des Torrent is another beach accessible from San Antonio.Nightlife and EntertainmentSome travelers have highlighted the vibrant nightlife in San Antonio, mentioning the Sunset Strip specifically. Popular spots like Mambo, Cafe Del Mar, and Savannah are recommended for their lively atmosphere and stunning sunset views.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Was this helpful?Resort AppealAccording to forum posts, Santa Eulalia is highly recommended for its cosmopolitan atmosphere, which includes a scenic promenade, a marina, and a variety of bars and restaurants. It suits a wide range of visitors, from families to senior travelers.Dining and ShoppingTravelers have called out Santa Eulalia for its abundance of fantastic restaurants and a great selection of shops. The town is noted for offering a relaxed dining atmosphere with a variety of price points, which can be as reasonable as €70 for a meal for two at a beachfront location.Accommodation and AccessibilitySome travelers mentioned that Santa Eulalia provides good transport links to other areas of Ibiza, making it convenient for guests who wish to explore the island. The town also features a mix of modern and traditional accommodations, appealing to different tastes and budgets.Family and Senior FriendlyFor many users, Santa Eulalia is described as suitable for both families and seniors, offering a peaceful environment with easy access to essential amenities and the beach, making it a practical choice for less mobile visitors.This summary was generated by AI from Tripadvisor forum posts. Please read full forum posts for more details and information.Frequently Asked Questions about IbizaIf you're a more budget-conscious traveler, then you may want to consider traveling to Ibiza between March and May, when hotel prices are generally the lowest. Peak hotel prices generally start between December and February.
